tickets.title: ticket 2
tickets.body:
## Problem
The gate reads a stale receipt and passes a head it never judged, so an unreviewed change can merge today.
## Repro
```
ai/bin/critic-review --head x
```
## Affected code
`ai/bin/critic-review:120`
